description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dambana, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710064 (23/0164)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels with their ownership status, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land settlement matters, including declarations about title determinations for multiple land parcels in specific locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
